title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical recruiter (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Reboot Monkey Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. About the Role Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave. As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings Requirements 3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts) Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring Fluent written and spoken English Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Data engineer iii
description:

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging market trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Cloud engineer

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Designer gráfico (foco em social media & motion)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer gráfico (foco em social media & motion) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Designer Gráfico (Foco em Social Media & Motion - PJ) Pacote de remuneração: R$ 3.000,00/mês Previdência Privada (opcional) Férias Remuneradas Modelo: Remoto Como se candidatar: Envie seu currículo e portfólio atualizado para Sobre a Posição Buscamos um Designer Gráfico criativo e antenado para integrar nosso time. O foco principal será criação de KVs e desdobramento de peças para canais online e a criação de conteúdos dinâmicos (motion design). Se você tem um olhar estético apurado, domina as ferramentas de edição e gosta de transformar estática em movimento, essa vaga é para você. Responsabilidades Desdobramento de Peças: Adaptar identidades visuais para diversos formatos de redes sociais (Feed, Stories, Reels, Carrosséis). Criação em Motion: Desenvolver posts animados e elementos em motion design para elevar o nível de engajamento das marcas. Comunicação Visual: Desenvolver peças gráficas para canais digitais (banners, e-mail marketing, apresentações) e eventuais materiais offline. Colaboração Criativa: Participar de briefings para sugerir soluções visuais que sigam as tendências atuais. Requisitos Formação concluída ou em fase final em Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas. Domínio do Pacote Adobe/Figma: Photoshop e Illustrator são essenciais. Motion Design: Conhecimento em After Effects ou ferramentas similares para animação de posts. Portfólio que demonstre habilidades em composição, tipografia e ritmo de vídeo. Capacidade de produção independente e atenção aos detalhes. Organização para lidar com volume de entregas e prazos. Diferenciais Trends: Estar por dentro das linguagens e estéticas do Tik Tok/Reels. Experiência prévia no mercado de seguros ou tecnologia. Por que trabalhar com a Segbox? Valorizamos a autonomia e a flexibilidade. Acreditamos em um equilíbrio saudável entre vida profissional e pessoal. Aqui, suas ideias têm voz e sua criatividade é o motor que ajuda a transformar o mercado de seguros. Sobre a Segbox A Segbox é uma empresa de tecnologia e inovação para o mercado de seguros. Fazemos parte da maior assessoria de seguros do país e somos responsáveis pela presença digital de diversas contas e sites do segmento.

title: Aem subject matter expert (sme)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Aem subject matter expert (sme) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking an experienced AEM Subject Matter Expert (SME) who can work closely with US-based clients to assess, define, and enhance their Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) ecosystem. The ideal candidate should possess deep expertise across AEM components and be capable of conducting discovery workshops, understanding existing landscapes, and recommending scalable solutions. AEM Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Consultant / Lead Location: Remote / Onsite (Client-facing role) Experience: 8+ Years Employment Type: Contract Key Responsibilities Conduct detailed discovery sessions with US clients to understand their current AEM landscape, architecture, and business requirements. Analyze existing AEM implementations and identify opportunities for optimization and modernization. Provide subject matter expertise across AEM suite components including: AEM Sites AEM Assets AEM Forms AEM Cloud Service AEM Headless / APIs Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to define technical roadmaps and best practices. Recommend scalable and future-ready AEM solutions aligned with client objectives. Support proposal discussions, solution design, and technical assessments. Provide guidance on AEM integrations, workflows, templates, components, and content migration strategies. Required Skills & Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Suite. Proven experience in client-facing consulting or discovery engagements. Excellent understanding of AEM architecture and enterprise content management ecosystems. Experience conducting workshops and gathering requirements from business and technical stakeholders. Knowledge of: Java, Sling, OSGi HTL/Sightly REST APIs Adobe Cloud Manager CI/CD practices Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to work with cross-functional global teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service. Adobe certifications in AEM technologies. Experience with Digital Experience Platforms (DXP). Exposure to analytics, personalization, or Adobe ecosystem tools is a plus. Soft Skills Strong consulting mindset Problem-solving and analytical skills Stakeholder management Excellent verbal and written communication Ability to lead discussions independently Engagement Expectations Work closely with US clients and offshore teams. Lead discovery and assessment discussions. Provide strategic recommendations and technical guidance around AEM capabilities and components.

title: Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're building a curated network of Spanish-speaking and Portuguese-speaking language professionals from Latin America to participate in AI training and evaluation projects with leading AI platforms, research labs, and data companies. This opportunity is ideal for translators, linguists, language professionals, bilingual communicators, and detail-oriented speakers interested in flexible, remote AI-related work. Candidates may apply with expertise in either Spanish OR Portuguese — proficiency in both languages is NOT required. Prior AI experience is NOT required. Unlike traditional full-time roles, these projects are task-based and platform-dependent. Work availability, compensation, and project duration may vary over time. About the Role Selected candidates may be guided through onboarding processes for AI training platforms working with multilingual datasets, language evaluation workflows, speech and text annotation, localization tasks, and AI-generated content review. Typical tasks may include: • Reviewing, evaluating, and improving AI-generated text or speech outputs in Spanish or Portuguese • Identifying linguistic inconsistencies, grammar issues, localization errors, or cultural nuances • Supporting multilingual evaluation, annotation, transcription, translation, or content quality workflows Projects are generally flexible and remote, allowing contributors to work independently on their own schedules. Who We're Looking For We're primarily looking for: • Spanish or Portuguese speakers • Translators • Linguists • Language teachers • Localization specialists • Editors and proofreaders • Communication or humanities students/professionals Preferred qualifications: • Strong written communication skills • Excellent grammar and attention to detail • Solid English comprehension • Experience in translation, editing, localization, or language-related work • Ability to identify tone, nuance, and linguistic inconsistencies • Familiarity with AI, language tools, or annotation platforms is a plus, but not required Important Transparency About the Process Vintti AI is NOT the company directly hiring for these projects. Our role is to identify and represent high-potential LATAM language talent, help candidates navigate onboarding and platform assessments, and share opportunities that may fit their backgrounds. We do not control platform acceptance decisions, project availability, task allocation, or future earnings. Compensation Compensation varies depending on the platform, the project, task complexity and contributor performance. Current market rates for language-related AI projects may range approximately between: USD 20–95/hour, depending on expertise, language specialization, and assignment type. These projects are generally best suited as flexible remote work, freelance income or an additional professional revenue stream, rather than a guaranteed full-time position. Vintti AI Representation Model This model helps support onboarding guidance, candidate support, project navigation and future access to additional AI-related opportunities. Full details are discussed transparently before any formal commitment. Why This Is Interesting AI companies increasingly need human language expertise — not just general annotators. Spanish and Portuguese speakers are becoming essential for training AI systems capable of multilingual communication, localization and translation, speech recognition, cultural adaptation, content evaluation and natural language understanding. This is an opportunity to participate directly in the development of next-generation AI systems while working remotely and flexibly.

title: Data engineer iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer iii em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes) (local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro) O que você vai fazer? - Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura). - Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite). - Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas. - Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade. - Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação). - Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas. - Reunião com clientes e stakeholders. Qual a formação? - Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica. - Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados. O que precisa ter para participar? - Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal). - Perfil proativo. - Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação. - Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia). - Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas. Indispensável: - Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura - Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato. description:

Context We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base. Mission As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity. Bonus Qualifications Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Fx trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're building a curated network of Spanish-speaking and Portuguese-speaking language professionals from Latin America to participate in AI training and evaluation projects with leading AI platforms, research labs, and data companies. This opportunity is ideal for translators, linguists, language professionals, bilingual communicators, and detail-oriented speakers interested in flexible, remote AI-related work. Candidates may apply with expertise in either Spanish OR Portuguese — proficiency in both languages is NOT required. Prior AI experience is NOT required. Unlike traditional full-time roles, these projects are task-based and platform-dependent. Work availability, compensation, and project duration may vary over time. About the Role Selected candidates may be guided through onboarding processes for AI training platforms working with multilingual datasets, language evaluation workflows, speech and text annotation, localization tasks, and AI-generated content review. Typical tasks may include: • Reviewing, evaluating, and improving AI-generated text or speech outputs in Spanish or Portuguese • Identifying linguistic inconsistencies, grammar issues, localization errors, or cultural nuances • Supporting multilingual evaluation, annotation, transcription, translation, or content quality workflows Projects are generally flexible and remote, allowing contributors to work independently on their own schedules. Who We're Looking For We're primarily looking for: • Spanish or Portuguese speakers • Translators • Linguists • Language teachers • Localization specialists • Editors and proofreaders • Communication or humanities students/professionals Preferred qualifications: • Strong written communication skills • Excellent grammar and attention to detail • Solid English comprehension • Experience in translation, editing, localization, or language-related work • Ability to identify tone, nuance, and linguistic inconsistencies • Familiarity with AI, language tools, or annotation platforms is a plus, but not required Important Transparency About the Process Vintti AI is NOT the company directly hiring for these projects. Our role is to identify and represent high-potential LATAM language talent, help candidates navigate onboarding and platform assessments, and share opportunities that may fit their backgrounds. We do not control platform acceptance decisions, project availability, task allocation, or future earnings. Compensation Compensation varies depending on the platform, the project, task complexity and contributor performance. Current market rates for language-related AI projects may range approximately between: USD 20–95/hour, depending on expertise, language specialization, and assignment type. These projects are generally best suited as flexible remote work, freelance income or an additional professional revenue stream, rather than a guaranteed full-time position. Vintti AI Representation Model This model helps support onboarding guidance, candidate support, project navigation and future access to additional AI-related opportunities. Full details are discussed transparently before any formal commitment. Why This Is Interesting AI companies increasingly need human language expertise — not just general annotators. Spanish and Portuguese speakers are becoming essential for training AI systems capable of multilingual communication, localization and translation, speech recognition, cultural adaptation, content evaluation and natural language understanding. This is an opportunity to participate directly in the development of next-generation AI systems while working remotely and flexibly.

Requisitos obrigatórios
Graduação em Medicina; CRM ativo e regular; Formação em Psiquiatria através de: Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida; Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico; Boa comunicação e postura ética; Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento; Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos. Documentação obrigatóriaO profissional deverá apresentar: Currículo atualizado; Documento de identificação profissional; CRM ativo; Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina; Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM; Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM; Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria; RQE (quando aplicável); Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma. Processo seletivoApós análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição. Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail: Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do Whats App: informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional. Diferenciais Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência; Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência; Formação complementar em psicoterapia; Fluência em outros idiomas; Disponibilidade para educação continuada. Modelo de atuação
Atendimento 100% online; Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica; Flexibilidade de agenda; Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas; Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional. A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico: Mantenha disponibilidade regular no Whats App para comunicação com a equipe da clínica; Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas; Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável; Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento. title: Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI. We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale. Why This Role Might Be for You Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn. You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate. Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build. Key Responsibilities Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities. Today: Execution and Precision Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance. Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable. Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously. Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases. Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer. Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage. What We're Looking For Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required. Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company. Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as Open AI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock. Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact. What We Offer Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture. High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI. Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful. Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil. Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us. Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company's story.

title: Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes) (local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro) O que você vai fazer? - Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura). - Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite). - Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas. - Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade. - Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação). - Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas. - Reunião com clientes e stakeholders. Qual a formação? - Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica. - Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados. O que precisa ter para participar? - Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal). - Perfil proativo. - Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação. - Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia). - Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas. Indispensável: - Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura - Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato. Se identificou com esta vaga? Então atualize seu currículo e se cadastre na vaga até 26/05/2026. #vaga #seleção #agro #agronegócio #tech #software #futuro #qualidade #startup #indicadores #comercial #vendas #banco #créditorural #financeiro #banco #finanças #sensoriamentoremoto #cartografia #Qgis   X valorizamos a diversidade e entendemos que o que acrescenta é justamente ideias e pontos de vistas variados.
